title: Boomerang-shaped street lamp bracket (Sarawak)
description: When the pole base or stickers are not visible, street lamps help: a boomerang- or banana-shaped metal piece on the lamp is exclusive to Sarawak (compare with the Peninsular lamp shown).

title: Barbed wire around poles (Sabah)
description: In Malaysia, barbed wire wrapped around utility poles is reportedly exclusive to Sabah and quite reliable.

title: Limestone towers of Perlis and Kedah
description: Large, very steep limestone rock formations rising abruptly from the plain indicate north-western Peninsular Malaysia: Perlis or Kedah.

title: Alam Flora bins (Pahang, Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya)
description: Green rubbish bins with the Alam Flora logo, a landscape with a rising sun, are found in Pahang, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya. Bins in Kuantan seem to have been replaced recently.

title: SWM Environment bins (Johor, Malacca, Negeri Sembilan)
description: Grey rubbish bins with the S-shaped SWM Environment logo are found in Johor, Malacca and Negeri Sembilan.

title: E-Idaman bins (Perlis, Kedah)
description: Dark green rubbish bins with the Environment Idaman logo, two leaves forming a V, are found in Perlis and Kedah.

title: Square-section 'bitten' poles of Sarawak
description: Besides the standard Sarawak pole (two insulators on one side of the crossarm, one on the other), other pole types are unique to Sarawak, especially in towns: this one looks like a Thai pole (square section, holes at the bottom) with a U-shaped metal piece halfway up that makes it look 'bitten'.

title: Jawi script (Kelantan)
description: Jawi script (Malay written in Arabic letters) on signs suggests you are most likely in Kelantan, in the north-east of the peninsula.

title: Striped 2021 Google car
description: The rare 2021 striped car in Peninsular Malaysia narrows you down to under 20 km: it appears around the Kelantan–Terengganu border near the coast. The 'Strip 21 exposed' variant is found near Kuala Perlis, around George Town (Penang), in south-western Selangor south of Shah Alam, and in central Pahang west of Kuantan.
